title.en: Launch nine language-scoped fixed-term course packages
title.zh: 上线九个按语言授权的固定期限课程套餐

purpose.en: Replace the former recurring-course assumptions with a language-first catalog of nine fixed-term packages and grant access only to the selected language course.
purpose.zh: 以先选学习语言、再选九个固定期限套餐的新目录替换旧的周期订阅假设，并只开通用户所选语言课程。

en: Offer Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced courses for 3, 6, or 12 months at $30/$50/$80, $60/$100/$160, and $120/$200/$320.
Offer Polygon USDT and GLC checkout only for the three-month package of each course level.
Encode the selected learning language as SmartPay3 secondId and grant the matching language-course access period.
zh: 仅三个等级的三个月套餐提供 Polygon USDT 与 GLC 支付。
将所选学习语言写入 SmartPay3 secondId，并为对应语言课程开通学习期限。

en: Course catalog and detail pages, card and SmartPay3 checkout, payment reconciliation, course access, college revenue sharing, admin crypto rails, and course-credit redemption.
zh: 课程目录与详情页、信用卡与 SmartPay3 结账、付款对账、课程权限、学院分成、管理员加密支付通道及课程积分兑换。

en: Add an authoritative nine-row package catalog and immutable payment-purchase evidence with language, level, duration, price, and access dates.
Use one-time Stripe payments for all nine packages and calendar-month access extension without automatic renewal.
Replace the legacy monthly and first-month-free schedule label on official course pages with fixed-term, no-auto-renewal language.
Normalize existing Polygon USDT and GLC token amounts to the three-month prices while preserving legacy constrained columns as non-authoritative compatibility data.
zh: 新增权威九行套餐目录及不可混用的付款记录，保存语言、等级、期限、价格和学习起止日期。
九个套餐全部使用 Stripe 一次性付款，按自然月延长学习期限且不自动续费。
将官方课程页遗留的按月与首月免费安排文案替换为固定期限、无自动续费说明。
将现有 Polygon USDT 与 GLC 代币数量统一为三个月价格，同时保留旧约束字段作为非权威兼容数据。

en: Pass the production build, zero-warning lint, TypeScript, 68-migration replay and idempotency checks, payment and language-scope contracts, and anonymous browser package-selection checks.
zh: 通过生产构建、零警告 lint、TypeScript、68 个迁移的重放与幂等检查、付款和语言范围契约，以及匿名浏览器套餐选择检查。

en: No real card or token transaction is submitted by automated testing; Polygon checkout remains unavailable until matching SmartPay3 rules are published by the authorized wallet owner.
zh: 自动测试不会提交真实信用卡或代币交易；在授权钱包所有者发布匹配的 SmartPay3 规则前，Polygon 结账保持不可用。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's independent Clerk, D1, Stripe, SmartPay3, college, user, and course-data boundaries and the existing GitHub Actions to Cloudflare release path.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 独立的 Clerk、D1、Stripe、SmartPay3、学院、用户与课程数据边界，以及既有 GitHub Actions 到 Cloudflare 发布流程。

rollback.en: This release includes additive D1 migration 0173. It does not delete historical data. A code rollback restores the prior Worker while the additive tables remain; any schema correction must use a new forward migration.
rollback.zh: 本次包含前向追加 D1 迁移 0173，不删除历史数据。代码回退只恢复上一版 Worker，追加表继续保留；任何结构修正必须使用新的前向迁移。
